scripts.name: GitHub workflow: build (build-fallback.yml)
scripts.script:
# from .github/workflows/build-fallback.yml, job 'build'
ioxcode-step 'Apply tamaios_changes.patch if it is in the repo' '.' '' 
ioxcode-step 'Install XcodeGen' '.' '' YnJldyBpbnN0YWxsIHhjb2RlZ2Vu
ioxcode-step 'Prepare promoted hash-verified emulator core' '.' '' c2V0IC1ldW8gcGlwZWZhaWwKcHl0aG9uMyB0b29scy9wcmVwYXJlX2NvcmUucHkgLS12YXJpYW50IHByb21vdGVkCg==
ioxcode-step 'Build Rust static library for iOS' '.' '' 
ioxcode-step 'Fetch firmware and assets from the private repo (if configured)' '.' 'PRIVATE_TOKEN='\'''\''' 
ioxcode-step 'Bundle firmware and MyMeets assets into the app' '.' '' 
ioxcode-step 'Draw the app icon' '.' '' 
ioxcode-step 'Generate Xcode project' '.' '' Y2QgaW9zCnhjb2RlZ2VuIGdlbmVyYXRlCg==
ioxcode-step 'Package the Xcode project (sources, generated project, Rust library)' '.' '' c2V0IC1ldW8gcGlwZWZhaWwKY2QgaW9zCnppcCAtcXJ5IC4uL1RhbWFpT1MtWGNvZGUtcHJvamVjdC56aXAgLiAteCAiYnVpbGQvKiIgIiouaXBhIiAiUGF5bG9hZC8qIiAiLkRTX1N0b3JlIgpscyAtbGggLi4vVGFtYWlPUy1YY29kZS1wcm9qZWN0LnppcAo=
echo 'note: skipping '\''Upload Xcode project artifact'\'' (actions/upload-artifact@v4): GitHub actions don'\''t run on iPhone'
echo '== '\''Build unsigned IPA'\'' is the Xcode build: iOXcode takes over from here'
